findings.location: Definition, introductory Sobolev/ACL equivalence, as initially observed; currently corrected
findings.evidence: The initially read equivalence omitted square-integrability of the ACL coordinate derivatives. On (-1,1)^2, f(x+iy)=sgn(x)|x|^(1/4)+iy is an ACL homeomorphism whose x derivative is not locally square-integrable. The opened ACL characterization requires this integrability. Another writer has now supplied the condition. This historical observation is retained without claiming a byte binding to the defective version. The assigned consumer directly depends on this batch-12 definition.

findings.evidence: Initially, (b) equated vanishing of f_bar_z with vanishing of mu_f for a Sobolev homeomorphism. Another writer has now added that condition on {f_z=0}. Retain the historical observation; the defective bytes were not bound to an immutable snapshot. The assigned round-circle lemma directly uses this batch-12 theorem.
